### Espoused to Christ - Love Worth Finding - September 21
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-21.html
Passage: Revelation 19:1
Points:
- Earthly wedding celebrations pale in comparison to the beauty of the church when Christ returns for His bride.
- Salvation functions as a holy espousal, establishing a binding pledge of belonging before the final consummation.
- God confirms this relationship by giving believers the Holy Spirit as an enduring seal.
- Contemplating the heavenly multitude's praise should move believers into immediate worship of the Lord.

### Daily Disciples - February 29
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-february-29.html
Passage: Revelation 19:1
Points:
- Rapid technological shifts and societal conditioning remind Christians of the reality of biblical prophecy.
- Believers do not need to respond to modern developments with fear, confusion, or rebellion.
- God remains completely sovereign, and His plans will be fulfilled in His timing.
- Christians should keep their eyes fixed on Christ's return and use present opportunities to share the gospel.
